name: dicebound
description: Dicebound: Chat Raiders — Telegram Mini App

scripts.dev: npm run build:server && concurrently -k -n api,bot,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @dicebound/api" "npm run dev -w @dicebound/bot" "npm run dev -w @dicebound/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:server && npm run dev -w @dicebound/api
scripts.dev:bot: npm run build:server && npm run dev -w @dicebound/bot
scripts.build:server: tsc -b packages/shared-types packages/game-core packages/db apps/api apps/bot
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build:server && npm run build -w @dicebound/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:server && npm run typecheck -w @dicebound/web && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.check: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check
